overview.Name: Breakwave Tanker Shipping ETF
overview.Description: Freight Futures reflect market expectations for the future cost of transporting crude oil. Each Reference index is published each United Kingdom business day by the London-based Baltic Exchange Ltd. and measures the charter rate for shipping crude oil in a specific size category of cargo ship and for a specific route.
